_README: Coordinates for the Map of Artemesia on rectrixcaedere.com.
This file is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for where a place sits on the map image.
generate_public_session_index.mjs reads it and emits the map block that
where-the-flowers-forget/archive.html renders. Before 2026-08-31 these
values were hardcoded in that HTML file.
x and y are PERCENTAGES of the map image (0-100), measured from the
top-left corner of /assets/img/Artemesia_Map.webp (aspect ratio 980x735).
TO ADD A NEW LOCATION: open the map image, estimate the x/y percentage,
add an entry here, then put its key in the session note's `site_location`.
A session pointing at a key that is missing here makes the generator FAIL
loudly rather than silently drop a bloom off the map.
Keys are lowercase, no spaces, and must stay stable once published -
they are what session frontmatter refers to.

_README: Markers placed on the map whose labels could not be read at the available
resolution. Each carries a "ring" id drawn on Artemesia_MAP_GRID.png and a
"grid" cell, so the image and this file cross-reference directly.
EMPTY as of 2026-08-31 — Taylor named all six. Block kept so the pattern is
reusable the next time a label cannot be read.
To publish one: give it a name and move it into "locations".
Nothing here reaches the site - the generator only reads "locations".
Reference grid drawn on Artemesia_MAP_GRID.png.
16 columns numbered 1-16 across, 12 rows lettered A-L down.
A cell ref is ROW LETTER then COLUMN NUMBER, e.g. "F7".
Every entry in locations and unnamed_markers carries its "grid" cell,
so a cell on the image maps straight to an entry in this file.
